record.title: Turkey–Armenia longstanding land-border closure
record.exceptions: Humanitarian aid crossed Margara–Alijan 11 and 15 February 2023; diplomatic arrangements do not establish general reopening.
record.enforcement: Armenian official history documents closure and limited aid crossings.
record.status_observation: Ordinary land border still closed 13 May 2026
record.official_rationale: Turkey closed the frontier in 1993 in solidarity with Azerbaijan during the Karabakh conflict; AP attributes this to Turkey’s position.
record.context: Baseline closed regime preceding study window; normalisation negotiations continue.
record.uncertainty: Limited humanitarian aid crossings in 2023 did not restore ordinary travel. May 2026 direct-trade documentation easing applies to routes through third countries and is not a land reopening.
